entries.task_id: he|will|waste their deeds
entries.description: He will waste their deeds
entries.subject: He

spans.text: [1] AR: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَصَدُّوا۟ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ أَضَلَّ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ EN: Those who disbelieve and avert [people] from the way of Allah - He will waste their deeds.
[5] AR: سَيَهْدِيهِمْ وَيُصْلِحُ بَالَهُمْ EN: He will guide them and amend their condition
[8] AR: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فَتَعْسًۭا لَّهُمْ وَأَضَلَّ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ EN: But those who disbelieve - for them is misery, and He will waste their deeds.

entries.subject: in what
entries.object: been sent down upon Muhammad - and it is the truth from their Lord - He will remove from them their misdeeds and amend their condition

spans.text: [2] AR: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَءَامَنُوا۟ بِمَا نُزِّلَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍۢ وَهُوَ ٱلْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّهِمْ ۙ كَفَّرَ عَنْهُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمْ وَأَصْلَحَ بَالَهُمْ EN: And those who believe and do righteous deeds and believe in what has been sent down upon Muhammad - and it is the truth from their Lord - He will remove from them their misdeeds and amend their condition.

[16] AR: وَمِنْهُم مَّن يَسْتَمِعُ إِلَيْكَ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا خَرَجُوا۟ مِنْ عِندِكَ قَالُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْعِلْمَ مَاذَا قَالَ ءَانِفًا ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ طَبَعَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓا۟ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ EN: And among them, [O Muhammad], are those who listen to you, until when they depart from you, they say to those who were given knowledge, "What has he said just now?"

spans.text: [3] AR: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱتَّبَعُوا۟ ٱلْبَٰطِلَ وَأَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱتَّبَعُوا۟ ٱلْحَقَّ مِن رَّبِّهِمْ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يَضْرِبُ ٱللَّهُ لِلنَّاسِ أَمْثَٰلَهُمْ EN: That is because those who disbelieve follow falsehood, and those who believe follow the truth from their Lord.
[9] AR: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ كَرِهُوا۟ مَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ فَأَحْبَطَ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ EN: That is because they disliked what Allah revealed, so He rendered worthless their deeds.

[11] AR: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَوْلَى ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَأَنَّ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ لَا مَوْلَىٰ لَهُمْ EN: That is because Allah is the protector of those who have believed and because the disbelievers have no protector.

spans.text: [17] AR: وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱهْتَدَوْا۟ زَادَهُمْ هُدًۭى وَءَاتَىٰهُمْ تَقْوَىٰهُمْ EN: And those who are guided - He increases them in guidance and gives them their righteousness.

folded.id: he|ordered|armed struggle] to test some of you by means of others
folded.subject: He
folded.object: armed struggle] to test some of you by means of others

spans.text: And if Allah had willed, He could have taken vengeance upon them [Himself], but [He ordered armed struggle] to test some of you by means of others.

folded.id: he|will|support you and plant firmly your feet
folded.subject: He
folded.object: support you and plant firmly your feet

spans.text: [7] AR: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِن تَنصُرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ يَنصُرْكُمْ وَيُثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَكُمْ EN: O you who have believed, if you support Allah, He will support you and plant firmly your feet.

folded.id: he|will|waste their deeds
folded.subject: He

spans.text: [1] AR: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَصَدُّوا۟ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ أَضَلَّ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ EN: Those who disbelieve and avert [people] from the way of Allah - He will waste their deeds.
[5] AR: سَيَهْدِيهِمْ وَيُصْلِحُ بَالَهُمْ EN: He will guide them and amend their condition
[8] AR: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فَتَعْسًۭا لَّهُمْ وَأَضَلَّ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ EN: But those who disbelieve - for them is misery, and He will waste their deeds.

folded.id: if allah|had|willed
folded.subject: if Allah

spans.text: And if Allah had willed, He could have taken vengeance upon them [Himself], but [He ordered armed struggle] to test some of you by means of others.

folded.id: if they|had|been true to allah
folded.subject: if they

spans.text: And when the matter [of fighting] was determined, if they had been true to Allah, it would have been better for them.

folded.id: in what|has|been sent down upon muhammad - and it is the truth from their lord - he will remove from them their misdeeds and amend their condition
folded.subject: in what
folded.object: been sent down upon Muhammad - and it is the truth from their Lord - He will remove from them their misdeeds and amend their condition

spans.text: [2] AR: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَءَامَنُوا۟ بِمَا نُزِّلَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍۢ وَهُوَ ٱلْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّهِمْ ۙ كَفَّرَ عَنْهُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمْ وَأَصْلَحَ بَالَهُمْ EN: And those who believe and do righteous deeds and believe in what has been sent down upon Muhammad - and it is the truth from their Lord - He will remove from them their misdeeds and amend their condition.

[16] AR: وَمِنْهُم مَّن يَسْتَمِعُ إِلَيْكَ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا خَرَجُوا۟ مِنْ عِندِكَ قَالُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْعِلْمَ مَاذَا قَالَ ءَانِفًا ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ طَبَعَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓا۟ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ EN: And among them, [O Muhammad], are those who listen to you, until when they depart from you, they say to those who were given knowledge, "What has he said just now?"

folded.id: never|will|he waste their deeds
folded.subject: never

spans.text: And those who are killed in the cause of Allah - never will He waste their deeds.

folded.id: precise surah|is|revealed and fighting is mentioned therein
folded.subject: precise surah
folded.object: revealed and fighting is mentioned therein

spans.text: But when a precise surah is revealed and fighting is mentioned therein, you see those in whose hearts is hypocrisy looking at you with a look of one overcome by death.

folded.id: so he|deafened|them and blinded their vision
folded.subject: so He

spans.text: [23] AR: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَعَنَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ فَأَصَمَّهُمْ وَأَعْمَىٰٓ أَبْصَٰرَهُمْ EN: Those [who do so] are the ones that Allah has cursed, so He deafened them and blinded their vision.

folded.id: so he|rendered|worthless their deeds
folded.subject: so He

spans.text: [9] AR: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ كَرِهُوا۟ مَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ فَأَحْبَطَ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ EN: That is because they disliked what Allah revealed, so He rendered worthless their deeds.

folded.id: so|is|he who is on clear evidence from his lord like him to whom the evil of his work has been made attractive and they follow their [own] desires?
folded.subject: So
folded.object: he who is on clear evidence from his Lord like him to whom the evil of his work has been made attractive and they follow their [own] desires?

spans.text: [14] AR: أَفَمَن كَانَ عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَةٍۢ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ كَمَن زُيِّنَ لَهُۥ سُوٓءُ عَمَلِهِۦ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓا۟ أَهْوَآءَهُم EN: So is he who is on clear evidence from his Lord like him to whom the evil of his work has been made attractive and they follow their [own] desires?

folded.id: that allah|has|cursed
folded.subject: that Allah

spans.text: [23] AR: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَعَنَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ فَأَصَمَّهُمْ وَأَعْمَىٰٓ أَبْصَٰرَهُمْ EN: Those [who do so] are the ones that Allah has cursed, so He deafened them and blinded their vision.

folded.id: that there|is|no deity except allah and ask forgiveness for your sin and for the believing men and believing women
folded.subject: that there
folded.object: no deity except Allah and ask forgiveness for your sin and for the believing men and believing women

spans.text: [19] AR: فَٱعْلَمْ أَنَّهُۥ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ وَٱسْتَغْفِرْ لِذَنۢبِكَ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَٰتِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مُتَقَلَّبَكُمْ وَمَثْوَىٰكُمْ EN: So know, [O Muhammad], that there is no deity except Allah and ask forgiveness for your sin and for the believing men and believing women.

folded.id: that|is|because those who disbelieve follow falsehood
folded.subject: That
folded.object: because those who disbelieve follow falsehood

spans.text: [3] AR: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱتَّبَعُوا۟ ٱلْبَٰطِلَ وَأَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱتَّبَعُوا۟ ٱلْحَقَّ مِن رَّبِّهِمْ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يَضْرِبُ ٱللَّهُ لِلنَّاسِ أَمْثَٰلَهُمْ EN: That is because those who disbelieve follow falsehood, and those who believe follow the truth from their Lord.
[9] AR: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ كَرِهُوا۟ مَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ فَأَحْبَطَ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ EN: That is because they disliked what Allah revealed, so He rendered worthless their deeds.

[11] AR: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَوْلَى ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَأَنَّ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ لَا مَوْلَىٰ لَهُمْ EN: That is because Allah is the protector of those who have believed and because the disbelievers have no protector.

folded.id: the disbelievers|is|something comparable
folded.subject: the disbelievers

spans.text: Allah destroyed [everything] over them, and for the disbelievers is something comparable.

folded.id: the fire|will|be a residence for them
folded.subject: the Fire

spans.text: [12] AR: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُدْخِلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ جَنَّٰتٍۢ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ ۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ يَتَمَتَّعُونَ وَيَأْكُلُونَ كَمَا تَأْكُلُ ٱلْأَنْعَٰمُ وَٱلنَّارُ مَثْوًۭى لَّهُمْ EN: Indeed, Allah will admit those who have believed and done righteous deeds to gardens beneath which rivers flow, but those who disbelieve enjoy themselves and eat as grazing livestock eat, and the Fire will be a residence for them.

folded.id: the hour|should|come upon them unexpectedly?
folded.subject: the Hour

spans.text: [18] AR: فَهَلْ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا ٱلسَّاعَةَ أَن تَأْتِيَهُم بَغْتَةًۭ ۖ فَقَدْ جَآءَ أَشْرَاطُهَا ۚ فَأَنَّىٰ لَهُمْ إِذَا جَآءَتْهُمْ ذِكْرَىٰهُمْ EN: Then do they await except that the Hour should come upon them unexpectedly?

folded.id: water that|will|sever their intestines?
folded.subject: water that

spans.text: [15] AR: مَّثَلُ ٱلْجَنَّةِ ٱلَّتِى وُعِدَ ٱلْمُتَّقُونَ ۖ فِيهَآ أَنْهَٰرٌۭ مِّن مَّآءٍ غَيْرِ ءَاسِنٍۢ وَأَنْهَٰرٌۭ مِّن لَّبَنٍۢ لَّمْ يَتَغَيَّرْ طَعْمُهُۥ وَأَنْهَٰرٌۭ مِّنْ خَمْرٍۢ لَّذَّةٍۢ لِّلشَّٰرِبِينَ وَأَنْهَٰرٌۭ مِّنْ عَسَلٍۢ مُّصَفًّۭى ۖ وَلَهُمْ فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ وَمَغْفِرَةٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّهِمْ ۖ كَمَنْ هُوَ خَٰلِدٌۭ فِى ٱلنَّارِ وَسُقُوا۟ مَآءً حَمِيمًۭا فَقَطَّعَ أَمْعَآءَهُمْ EN: Is the description of Paradise, which the righteous are promised, wherein are rivers of water unaltered, rivers of milk the taste of which never changes, rivers of wine delicious to those who drink, and rivers of purified honey, in which they will have from all [kinds of] fruits and forgiveness from their Lord, like [that of] those who abide eternally in the Fire and are given to drink scalding water that will sever their intestines?

folded.id: we|destroyed|them
folded.subject: We

spans.text: We destroyed them; and there was no helper for them.

folded.id: when it|has|come
folded.subject: when it

spans.text: Then what good to them, when it has come, will be their remembrance?

folded.id: which he|has|made known to them
folded.subject: which He

spans.text: [6] AR: وَيُدْخِلُهُمُ ٱلْجَنَّةَ عَرَّفَهَا لَهُمْ EN: And admit them to Paradise, which He has made known to them.

folded.id: which they|will|have from all [kinds of] fruits and forgiveness from their lord
folded.subject: which they
folded.object: have from all [kinds of] fruits and forgiveness from their Lord

spans.text: [15] AR: مَّثَلُ ٱلْجَنَّةِ ٱلَّتِى وُعِدَ ٱلْمُتَّقُونَ ۖ فِيهَآ أَنْهَٰرٌۭ مِّن مَّآءٍ غَيْرِ ءَاسِنٍۢ وَأَنْهَٰرٌۭ مِّن لَّبَنٍۢ لَّمْ يَتَغَيَّرْ طَعْمُهُۥ وَأَنْهَٰرٌۭ مِّنْ خَمْرٍۢ لَّذَّةٍۢ لِّلشَّٰرِبِينَ وَأَنْهَٰرٌۭ مِّنْ عَسَلٍۢ مُّصَفًّۭى ۖ وَلَهُمْ فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ وَمَغْفِرَةٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّهِمْ ۖ كَمَنْ هُوَ خَٰلِدٌۭ فِى ٱلنَّارِ وَسُقُوا۟ مَآءً حَمِيمًۭا فَقَطَّعَ أَمْعَآءَهُمْ EN: Is the description of Paradise, which the righteous are promised, wherein are rivers of water unaltered, rivers of milk the taste of which never changes, rivers of wine delicious to those who drink, and rivers of purified honey, in which they will have from all [kinds of] fruits and forgiveness from their Lord, like [that of] those who abide eternally in the Fire and are given to drink scalding water that will sever their intestines?

folded.id: whom allah|has|sealed over their hearts and who have followed their [own] desires
folded.subject: whom Allah
folded.object: sealed over their hearts and who have followed their [own] desires

spans.text: Those are the ones of whom Allah has sealed over their hearts and who have followed their [own] desires.

folded.id: whose hearts|is|hypocrisy looking at you with a look of one overcome by death
folded.subject: whose hearts
folded.object: hypocrisy looking at you with a look of one overcome by death

spans.text: But when a precise surah is revealed and fighting is mentioned therein, you see those in whose hearts is hypocrisy looking at you with a look of one overcome by death.

folded.id: why|has|a surah not been sent down?
folded.subject: Why
folded.object: a surah not been sent down?

spans.text: [20] AR: وَيَقُولُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَوْلَا نُزِّلَتْ سُورَةٌۭ ۖ فَإِذَآ أُنزِلَتْ سُورَةٌۭ مُّحْكَمَةٌۭ وَذُكِرَ فِيهَا ٱلْقِتَالُ ۙ رَأَيْتَ ٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌۭ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَيْكَ نَظَرَ ٱلْمَغْشِىِّ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ ٱلْمَوْتِ ۖ فَأَوْلَىٰ لَهُمْ EN: Those who believe say, "Why has a surah not been sent down?
